messages:
Elena: Hey Marco — finalizing a short manager/HR onboarding checklist for new ICs starting next week. Posting draft below. Please edit.

Marco: quick scan looks good. add a line about hardware swap windows and who handles shipping.

Elena: added. Draft:

Elena: === QUICK MANAGER + HR ONBOARD CHECKLIST ===
Elena: Pre-start (48-72h)
Elena: - Badge & laptop ready for pickup (IT ticket IT-4780)
Elena: - Okta SSO + email created; send welcome note with first-day schedule
Elena: - Invite: 1:1 weekly (recurring), team standups, product sync

Elena: Day 1
Elena: - 09:00 Welcome + benefits overview (People Ops)
Elena: - 10:00 Manager intro: role priorities & first sprint (Manager)
Elena: - 11:00 Security quick-run (Security)
Elena: - Afternoon: dev setup & repo access (DevEx)

Elena: Quick "who to ask" list:
Elena: - Account, SSO, MFA issues: @it-support or raise https://redwood.internal/it
Elena: - Repo perms, GH org invites: @Jasper
Elena: - VPN / Private deployment creds: @Ravi
Elena: - Payroll, benefits, time-off: @people-ops
Elena: - Security/compliance: @security-oncall
Elena: - Hardware swaps, peripheral requests: @it-support (mark urgent if within 3 days)

Elena: Small snippets new hires will need:
Elena: ```
Elena: # generate ssh key
Elena: ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "you@company.com"
Elena: # add pubkey to GitHub
Elena: gh ssh-key add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub --title "Laptop"
Elena: ```

Marco: For managers: short 30/60/90 to share on day 2 — keep it outcome focused.

Elena: Proposed manager-facing 30/60/90 blurb:
Elena: - 30d: Onboarded: dev environment green, run tests, complete first bugfix/cleanup
Elena: - 60d: Productive: ship a small feature, demo to team, own a component's tickets
Elena: - 90d: Autonomous: lead a small roadmap item, drive postmortem/action items; begin oncall rotation

Jasper: Note: we require a GitHub username + public key before granting write perms — @Priya please DM.

Ravi: VPN note: if you get intermittent DNS issues, try switching to the "corp-dns" profile then restart the VPN client.

onboard-bot: Orientation deck created: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/pri-march-2026-deck

Elena: Escalation guide if blocked >24h:
Elena: 1) Ping the owner in "who to ask"
Elena: 2) If no reply in 6 hours, ping your manager with @mention
Elena: 3) After 24h unblocked request, People Ops will escalate to infra & IT

Priya: Thanks — got badge pickup details, will DM my ssh key. Also added my pronouns. :wave:

Marco: I'll take the 10:00 manager intro, and will set expectations for first sprint. Good to post in #new-hires Monday.

Elena: Thanks everyone — I'll post final and attach calendar template + checklist.
